G4157_1   GH19.DISPOSITION OF PENSION
          Section: G            Level: Respondent         CAI Reference: Q4157
          Type: Numeric         Width: 1                  Decimals: 0

          GH19.
                  When you left that employer, did you transfer
                  your account to a new employer, roll it over
